name: Arni Brokenbrow
description: A companion who flies with Tyvar and Kaya and stays behind to slow zombies.

description_citations.text: "Tyvar Kell". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alajn points out Arni Brokenbrow as the Tuskeri's new leader.
timeline.quote: That's their new leader. Arni Brokenbrow, they call him.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni draws his sword and grins as though straight at the unseen Njala.
timeline.quote: Then he grinned. In fact, he seemed to be grinning right at her.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Tuskeri charge the Skelle line with Arni at the front.
timeline.quote: the Tuskeri broke into a sudden charge, straight at the middle of the Skelle line

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni leaps over the Skelle spears and shields and kills a raider in the front row.
timeline.quote: the new leader of the Tuskeri leaped into the air

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The Tuskeri break the Skelle, who flee, and Arni sits laughing on a pile of the dead while Alajn finds her duties unneeded.
timeline.quote: Soon the Skelle were broken, fleeing across the open plains.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Hormgart begins the tale of how Arni, once called Goatleaper, got his new name (a story told in flashback).
timeline.quote: He was called Goatleaper, once,

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In Hormgart's tale, word of murderous trolls on the Red Ridge spreads and Arni's small band begins hunting them (flashback).
timeline.quote: word spread of a scourge of murderous trolls, terrorizing villages all along the Red Ridge

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Njala and Alajn watch Arni court death again, this time facing a hellkite in the Tusk mountains.
timeline.quote: it was a dragon

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni lassoes the hellkite's horn and is flung toward a stone spire, landing on it feet first.
timeline.quote: he flung the lasso straight into the path of the hellkite's head

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni rides the hellkite and kills it by driving his blade between its horns while his Tuskeri watch.
timeline.quote: all the Tuskeri gaped, wide-eyed, as their leader drove the blade between the creature's horns

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In Hormgart's tale, Arni's band finds a whole warren of trolls in a cave and decides not to leave for reinforcements (flashback).
timeline.quote: Creeping closer, Arni found far more than just a couple stone-eaters.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni steps out and proposes a headbutting contest to the trolls, the loser to leave the mountains forever (flashback).
timeline.quote: Loser packs up and leaves these mountains forever.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tover Giants-Blood and the Kannah warriors emerge from the Aldergard treeline to face Arni in an honor duel.
timeline.quote: Tover Giants-Blood was the biggest human Njala had ever seen.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Giants-Blood offers Arni a last chance to grovel and repent for desecrating his family's resting place, and Arni refuses.
timeline.quote: I'll give you one last chance to repent.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Giants-Blood feints and hits Arni in the jaw with the axe haft.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, Tover brought up the haft of the axe in a sharp jab, cracking into Arni's jaw and sending him flying.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni steps inside the swing and chops through the axe haft with his sword.
timeline.quote: chopped down at the wooden haft with his sword

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Giants-Blood catches Arni in a crushing bear hug and lifts him off the ground.
timeline.quote: Giants-Blood cinched him tight in a bear hug, pinning his arms to his side and lifting him off the ground

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Njala realizes she does not want Arni to die and decides she will not allow it.
timeline.quote: And yet, Njala found that she didn't want Arni to be crushed to death by this bear of a man.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Njala sees Arni grinning in the bear hug and remembers how Hormgart's story ended as he draws his head back.
timeline.quote: Arni drew his head back, back, back

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: In the headbutting contest with the troll, the frightened troll decides to cheat (flashback).
timeline.quote: he decided to cheat

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni breaks the troll's tusk with his skull, leaving bone embedded in his forehead and losing the name Goatleaper (flashback).
timeline.quote: the troll lay flat on his back, one of his tusks snapped off at the root

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
timeline.quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
timeline.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
timeline.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
timeline.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: At the crossroads, the leaders review losses and the draugr and demons that escaped.
timeline.quote: We broke the draugr lines and drove off their main body

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Representatives of Bretagard's clans gather at Beskir Stronghold with Tyvar and Kaya; Sigrid urges unity against the invaders.
timeline.quote: Sigrid urged unity, revealing that the realms faced a shared threat

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varragoth attacks the heroes on giant ravens; Kaya phases them into incorporeal form to survive the fall.
timeline.quote: Kaya managed to phase them into incorporeal form just before they hit the river below

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, Kaya and Arni fly toward Halvar with the Sword of the Realms but are attacked by Varragoth and fall near the Dread Marn.
timeline.quote: were attacked in midair by the demon Varragoth who wanted the Sword for himself

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arni leads the Tuskeri against Skelle raiders and quickly overwhelms them.
timeline.quote: Despite being outnumbered, the Tuskeri displayed remarkable bravery and combat prowess, quickly overwhelming their foes.

citation.text: "Alajn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arni subdues a hellkite using bravery and clever tactics.
timeline.quote: Arni managed to subdue it using a combination of bravery and clever tactics.

citation.text: "Alajn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arni defeats Tover Giants-Blood in an honor duel, breaking a bear hug with a headbutt.
timeline.quote: Arni's cunning and determination allowed him to break free with a headbutt and ultimately defeat the giant human.

citation.text: "Alajn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Njala sought out Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni Brokenbrow.
timeline.quote: the Valkyrie shepherd Njala sought out Hormgart to learn more about Arni Brokenbrow

citation.text: "Hormgart", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hormgart recounted how Goatleaper defeated trolls in the Tusk Mountains and became Arni Brokenbrow.
timeline.quote: Arni emerged victorious, with a troll's bone embedded in his forehead

citation.text: "Hormgart", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Njala and Alajn watch a skirmish where the outnumbered Tuskeri, led by Arni's bold charge, defeat the Skelle.
timeline.quote: Despite the odds, Arni led a bold charge, surprising the Skelle and ensuring a Tuskeri victory.

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Njala feels a strange connection when Arni seems to grin at her.
timeline.quote: Njala felt a strange connection when Arni appeared to grin at her

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Njala seeks out Hormgart, who explains how Arni earned the name Brokenbrow headbutting a troll.
timeline.quote: She sought out Hormgart, a dwarf skald in Starnheim, to learn more about Arni.

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arni lassos a hellkite dragon and drives his blade into its skull while Njala and Alajn watch.
timeline.quote: Arni's cunning prevailed as he lassoed the beast and drove his blade into its skull

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arni survives an honor duel with Tover Giants-Blood by headbutting him.
timeline.quote: Arni employed the same headbutt tactic that won him his name

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alrund advises taking the Sword to Halvar; Kaya, Tyvar and Arni fly on a giant raven but Varragoth attacks, and they fall near the Dread Marn.
timeline.quote: Mounted on a giant raven Kaya, Tyvar and Arni flew toward Halvar

citation.text: "Sword of the Realms", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Red-haired, grinning leader of the Tuskeri clan, who survives every fight the Valkyrie Njala expects to be his last and earns the name Brokenbrow by breaking a troll's tusk with his head.

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

pages_say.description: The grinning leader of the Tuskeri who holds off draugr so Kaya and Tyvar can reach the bridge.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

pages_say.description: A Tuskeri who headbutted a troll and won.
